hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Buying fruit i (1-indexed) lets you acquire fruits i + 1 up to 2 * i for free.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Let dp[i] be the minimum coins needed from fruit i to the end.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: dp[i] = prices[i - 1] + min(dp[i + 1], ..., dp[min(n + 1, 2 * i + 2)]). Use a monotonic deque to maintain minimums over sliding ranges in O(1) per step.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: size of input array or string
complexity.notes: Efficient execution matching optimal computational complexity.
